items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: He said in the morning... he was an old man. Old man. And the teeth missing. But he could take that trumpet... he'd play and show you what he wanted.

ctx.x: And I'll tell you what theory he had. He told all of us. Of course, I never took a drink. I guess I was about 21 years old before I took a drink of liquor. But he said in the morning, if a man is blowing a wind instrument, take him a hot tart in the morning. Hot tart is just hot water, no sugar, and whiskey. He said if you want to always have wind. Oh. And he was an old man. Old man. And the teeth missing. But he could take that trumpet, a little spit or fly to the side, but he'd play and show you what he wanted.…
